intent: Ten original photo-sharing tasks include four changing code-field masking previews: name+phone, phone-only, name-only and no personal fields. Keep the harmless project title, separate background checks from purpose and consent, respect refusal, seek trusted-adult help after inappropriate sharing and preserve uncertainty about remaining copies. Fresh robot-page transfer combines background and permission limits.
picturePurpose: Inspected original blank noticeboard and cardboard robot provide a fictional project-photo background. Exact demo name/phone/title fields and opaque masks are code; large hide/restore controls avoid tiny image targets. No real person or uploaded photo is processed. Passing the background check alone never approves posting.

transfer.stem: Which plan follows both the background task and the permission limit?
transfer.passage:
A FICTIONAL ROBOT-PROJECT PAGE
A group wants to move its project photograph from a private class chat to a public page. Everyone shown has agreed only to the private class chat, not to the public page. The background board contains a pupil’s name and telephone number, as well as the harmless project title ROBOT. The task is to keep the title readable while hiding the personal contact fields. Hiding those fields deals with the background; it does not replace checking agreement for the new public use.

options.text: Hide the name and phone number, then publish publicly because private-chat agreement already covers every use.
Hide the name and phone number, keep the project title, and check agreement for the new public use.
Hide only the project title, leave the name and phone number visible, and ask about public-use agreement.

answer.display: Hide the name and phone number, keep the project title, and check agreement for the new public use.

explanation.strategy: 把背景字段与分享用途分开查；不能用做好其中一项代替另一项。

steps.text: 遮挡姓名与电话号码，保留题目明确要求可读的项目标题。
steps.reason: 姓名和号码是本题的个人资料；标题不是。不能遮住标题却把个人资料留着。

steps.text: 从私聊改成公开页面，需要重新确认具体用途的同意。
steps.reason: 原来的同意只覆盖私聊；背景处理正确，也不会自动扩大许可范围。

distractors.reason: 背景处理正确，却把仅限私聊的同意扩大成所有用途的许可。
知道要确认新用途，但遮错了字段：把标题藏起来，反而留下姓名和电话。

explanation.pitfall: 背景干净与获得具体用途的同意是两项要求；部分正确不能让整个方案过关。
